notes.title: v1.2.4 Update
notes.content:
Weapon Changes

Shotgun: Increased range and pellet count (enough to one-shot Hosoinu if all pellets connect)
Frisbee

Increased fire rate for both Fire 1 and Fire 2
Increased damage for Fire 2 (enough to one-shot regular Listeners)

 Bonemerang

Increased fire rate for both Fire 1 and Fire 2
Bones travel faster and further

 Mion Cannon: Increased laser count (enough to one-shot Hosoinu if all lasers connect)
 BLT: Increased fire rate

Slightly decreased HP of Joshi and The Three Husketeers
Enemies now always render on top of Korone Boxes
Weapons Menu

Locked weapons now show how to unlock
Weapons with Fire 2 now show specific functions of Fire 1 and Fire 2

notes.title: v1.2.3 Update + Information for returning players
notes.content:
Firstly, thank you to everyone playing WOWOWOW KORONE BOX, whether you're a returning player or trying the game for the first time!

The Steam release contains various changes to improve the player experience:

Key rebinding
Improved weapon unlock process
Several weapons have additional alternate fire effects. Try using Fire 2 to find them!
Steam Achievements
Integration with Steam Leaderboards
Improved Japanese localization
Bug fixes and miscellaneous improvements

Information for returning players:

Unfortunately, save data from the itch.io versions will not carry over to this one. This is due to changes to the save format to support unique save data between Steam accounts.
A Mac build is currently not possible. Apologies for the inconvenience.
